nvitk.cli.morphology
====================

.. py:module:: nvitk.cli.morphology

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   ``nvitk-morph`` CLI — morphological image tools.

---------

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: main() -> None

   Morphology tools (binary ops, centerlines, ICA siphon correction).


.. py:function:: _morph_op(op)

   Wrap a base morphology *op* (e.g. :func:`~nvitk.morphology.dilate`) as a CLI runner that
   operates on the mask if one was supplied, else the input image itself.


.. py:function:: cmd_dilate(input_path, output_path, mask_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run, footprint)

   Binary dilation.


.. py:function:: cmd_erode(input_path, output_path, mask_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run, footprint)

   Binary erosion.


.. py:function:: cmd_open(input_path, output_path, mask_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run, footprint)

   Binary opening (erode then dilate).


.. py:function:: cmd_close(input_path, output_path, mask_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run, footprint)

   Binary closing (dilate then erode).


.. py:function:: cmd_fill_holes(input_path, output_path, mask_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run)

   Fill interior holes in a binary mask.


.. py:function:: cmd_label_cc(input_path, output_path, mask_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run)

   Label connected components in a binary mask.


.. py:function:: cmd_centerline(input_path, output_path, mask_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run)

   Compute a binary centerline/skeleton from a vessel mask.


.. py:function:: cmd_siphon(input_path, output_path, mask_path, tof_path, backend, submit, emit_script, direct_submit, no_remote, dry_run)

   Correct ICA siphon centerline geometry using a TOF MRA reference volume.
